text: Mailüfterl is an Austrian nickname for the first computer working solely on transistors on the European mainland. It was built in 1955 at the Vienna University by Heinz Zemanek. The builder plays on a quote about the rapid calculation speed of American models like Whirlwind, suggesting that it will be enough for a Wiener Mailüfterl. The full name is Binär Rechenautomat.
